items.text: A world-renowned street artist named Banksy created a new coronavirus-inspired artwork on the London Underground. The piece ’If You Don’t Mask, You Don’t Get’ was painted inside a Circle line carriage, and it encouraged people to wear face coverings while on public transport. However, by the time Banksy unveiled the work on his Instagram account, it had already been removed by Transport for London cleaning crew, in line with its strict anti-graffiti policy. Many commuters , regard graffiti as something threatening and unwelcoming, and in the current atmosphere of the coronavirus pandemic, commuters are happy that the cleaners did their job quickly. All public transport users in London must wear a face covering, and Transport of London said that it appreciated Banksy’s effort to encourage people to do so. It added that Banksy would get a chance to do a new version of his message in a suitable location. Difficult words: unveil (to reveal), in line with (according to), commuter (a person who travels to work or school), atmosphere (how people feel). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Banksy is a world-known British street artist and political activist ; however, nobody knows his real name. Banksy started to be active in the 1990s, and in his work, he often comments on political and social problems. Last week, he sprayed graffiti in a London subway. He wanted to support people during the coronavirus pandemic, and to remind them that they must wear masks in public transport. However, a cleaning crew cleaned Banksy’s work before he posted it on his Instagram account. In London, people must wear masks when they use public transport. Officials said that they welcomed Banksy’s support. However, they will find a more suitable place where he can do his work. Difficult words: activist (a person who works hard to make some changes, usually political or social), comment (to say what you think about something), support (to help). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Banksy is a British street artist. In his art, he says what he thinks about politics and society . He does a lot of work. Many people around the world know him. However, nobody knows his real name. Last week, Banksy sprays graffiti in a London subway. Banksy’s idea is to help people during the coronavirus pandemic . People in London must wear face masks in public transport . Banksy wants people to remember this rule. However, it is not legal to spray graffiti in the London subway. Cleaners clean the graffiti quickly. Cleaners do not know that the graffiti is Banksy’s work. Officials welcome Banksy’s help during the coronavirus pandemic. Officials will find a better place. Banksy can do his work there. Difficult words: society (a large group of people who have similar ideas and who live in the same place), spray graffiti (to write or draw on walls, houses, and other things with paint that comes out of a can), pandemic (a disease that makes people sick all over the world), public transport (the buses and trains that people use in towns and cities).http://spray+graffiti You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Thrill seekers in Japan will soon get to enjoy their favorite roller coasters again now that amusement parks around the country are reopening. However, a group of major theme operators has banned screaming on their roller coasters, and customers are advised to scream inside their hearts instead. The rule has been introduced to stop the spread of the coronavirus which is transferred from person to person by tiny air droplets . A theme park released a video of two of its executives wearing masks while riding an adrenaline ride in complete silence. In the video, one of the executives is wearing a suit, and he can be seen to calmly adjust his face mask. Difficult words: thrill seeker (a person who enjoys extreme sports and activities), droplet (a small drop), executive (someone who works in a company at a senior level), adrenaline (the chemical in your body that you feel when you are very excited). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A theme park in Japan released a funny video. In the video, two executives of the park are riding a roller coaster . They are wearing masks, and they stay quiet during the ride. Most people scream on rides; however, the two men stay calm. The reason why the men did not scream is that some theme parks in Japan banned screaming . Operators of the parks believe that this rule will help stop the spread of the coronavirus. If people do not scream, the coronavirus cannot spread so easily. The park that released the video told the visitors to scream inside their hearts. Difficult words: executive (a person with a high position in a company), screaming (when you yell very loudly), operator (a person or company that runs a business), spread (when something goes over a large area; to go over a large area). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People in Japan like to visit theme parks . They like dangerous rides and roller coasters . Now, many theme parks have a new rule. Visitors must not scream on rides. The reason is the coronavirus. People sit close to each other on rides. The coronavirus moves in the air. The coronavirus can move more easily when people scream. People must stay quiet. A theme park releases a video. In the video, two park employees ride a roller coaster. They are wearing masks. However, they stay calm during the ride. They do not scream. The theme park says that visitors can scream in their hearts. Difficult words: theme park (a place with rides and small shops where people go to have fun), roller coaster (a ride that can look like a train, and it goes up and down in the air), release (to show some work to many people for the first time). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The NFL’s Washington Redskins announced earlier this month that their team name would undergo a thorough review. The team’s head coach said that the team would develop a new name and logo and that the name would honor the military and Native Americans. The Redskins have had the name for nearly nine decades; however, some Native American groups and activists have criticized it as being an ethnic slur . A 2020 study found that 49% of Americans found the name offensive. The name review came after nearly 90 investment firms and shareholders pushed the companies Nike, FedEx, and PepsiCo to stop doing business with the team if the name was not changed. Difficult words: honor (to regard with great respect), ethnic slur (an insult about a group of people), shareholder (a person or company that owns a part of another company). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Washington Redskins is an American football team that plays in the NFL league. The team announced that it would change its name and logo . The decision came after some companies refused to do business with the team if the team did not change its name. The Redskins have had the name for almost 90 years; however, some people were not happy with it. Native Americans criticized the name, and they said that it was rude. In 2020, a study at the University of California found out that 49 % of Americans said that the logo was rude. The team’s coach said that the new name and logo would honor soldiers and Native Americans. Difficult words: logo (a symbol or design that a represents a company or product), refuse (to say that you will not do something or to not do something), criticize (to show problems with something), honor (to show respect). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Washington Redskins is an American football team. The team has a logo. A logo is a picture that represents the team. The logo is a head of Native American inside a yellow circle. Some people are not happy with the team’s name. Native Americans do not like the logo. Native Americans say that the team’s name is rude . Some companies want to stop business with the team. Now, the team must change its logo and name, too. The team’s coach says that the team will change its name and logo soon. The new name will honor soldiers and Native Americans. Difficult words: native (a person who originally lives in a place), rude (not nice or polite), honor (to show that someone or something is great). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

After weeks of intense flooding, nearly 300,000 people have been evacuated along the Yangtze River in eastern China. The downpour damaged homes and infrastructure , and it left many people without food and shelter. More than 5,000 people have been forced to evacuate as the massive floods moved east. In Poyang County, over two feet of rain has fallen, and the Chinese Fire department said that 54 boats were deployed to rescue almost 2,000 trapped people. Meanwhile, in Shexian County, post-disaster disinfection work has already started. According the local media, this has been the largest flood that the area has recorded in decades. Difficult words: downpour (heavy rain), infrastructure (the things that a city needs to runs such as electricity, water, or roads), deployed (brought into action), disinfection (cleaning). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A large flood hit eastern China, and officials said that it was the largest flood in the country in decades . The flood happened along the Yangtze River, which is the longest river in Asia. The flood lasted more than one week, and officials evacuated more than 300,000 people. Many people lost homes and they did not have anything to eat. In Poyang County, heavy rain destroyed towns and villages, and more than 5,000 people had to leave their homes. Officials used 54 boats to rescue almost 2,000 people. In Shexian county, people started to clean the streets and homes after the floods. Difficult words: decade (ten years), evacuate (to take somebody to a safe place), rescue (to save). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Big floods happen in eastern China. The flood happens on the Yangtze River. The Yangtze River is the longest river in Asia. It is the third longest river in the world. Officials say that it is the biggest flood in many years. The flood lasts one week. More than 300,000 people must leave their homes. The flood destroys many towns and villages. Many people lose their homes. People have nothing to eat. The flood destroys houses. Officials must use boats. They rescue people who are trapped . In some parts of the country, people already clean the streets and homes after the flood. Difficult words: flood (when there is too much water, and the water gets into streets and houses), destroy (to break so much that something cannot be fixed), rescue (to save), trapped (when someone is in a dangerous place or situation, and he cannot get out). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Lopburi, Thailand, is home to 6,000 macaques that draw tourism to the Thai city all year round. Before the coronavirus hit the country, tourists paid money to take pictures and feed the monkeys with fruit. However, when the lockdown happened, their regular food supply was stopped. As people stop visiting the city, the hungry monkeys turned violent, and they started to attack each other and people in the streets. To reduce the monkeys’ anger, locals began giving them sweets, fizzy drinks, and cereal. However, the high sugar diet made the monkeys sex crazed , and they have begun to breed faster than ever. The city has now been overrun and drastic action is being taken. Wildlife authorities are sedating and sterilizing a large number of the monkey population. Locals hope that it will help them take back control of the streets. Difficult words: sex-crazed (obsessed with sexual activity), sedate (to make a person or animal calm or go to sleep by giving them a drug), sterilize (to make a person or animal unable to have a baby). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many monkeys live in Thailand. In the city of Lopburi, there are about 6,000 macaques who attract thousands of tourists every year. Tourists pay money to take pictures and they feed the monkeys. However, the coronavirus stopped tourism, and the monkeys started to get hungry. They started to attack each other and people in the streets, too. Local people started to feed the monkeys. They gave them sweets, fizzy drinks , and cereals which had a very negative impact. Too much sugar in their diet made the monkeys more sexually active, and their population went up. Authorities decided to solve the problem, and they started to sterilize the monkeys. Local people hope that the streets will become calm again. Difficult words: attract (to make someone interested or come to a place), fizzy drink (a sweet drink with bubbles that has no alcohol), sterilize (to stop someone from having a baby). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Lopburi is a city in Thailand. About 6,000 macaques live in the city. Thousands of tourists come to see the monkeys every year. Tourists take pictures of the monkeys. Tourists give them food. However, the coronavirus stops tourism. Tourists do not come to the city. The monkeys are hungry. They start to get violent. They attack each other and people in the streets, too. Local people give the monkeys sweets, sweet drinks, and cereals. It brings another problem. Monkeys start to have more sex. The number of monkeys is growing fast. Officials must solve the problem. Vets sterilize the monkeys. They cannot have babies again. Difficult words: macaque (a type of a monkey with a long face), vet (an animal doctor), sterilize (to stop someone from having a baby). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

As schools around the world are beginning to reopen after the coronavirus pandemic, the question on many parent’s minds remains. Is it safe for kids to return to school? Deborah Birx is a coordinator of the White House Coronavirus Task Force and she suggests that in the case of the US, it really depends on where the school is. US schools begin to reopen next month, and many school districts rely on information from the CDC, the US health protection agency, how to safely reopen. However, Birx said that the agency sent mixed messages , and schools needed to look on CDC’s website for the current guidelines . Each school is different, as some schools may be in areas where outdoor classrooms are possible, and some schools may have a large gym that could be sectioned . In any case, fans and air circulation are also important to consider. Difficult words: mixed message (a message or communication that is unclear and can be interpreted in many ways), guideline (a general rule or piece of advice), sectioned (divided into separate parts or areas), air circulation (the movement of air). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Schools around the world closed because of the coronavirus. Now, schools are beginning to reopen, and many parents ask if they are safe for their children. Deborah Birx is the coronavirus coordinator of the US government. She says that in the US, it depends on where the school is because in some parts of the country, there are still many cases of COVID-19. Schools get information from the government; however, some information is not clear, and schools can interpret it differently. Schools need to follow some rules; however, each school is different. Some schools could have outdoor classes, and some schools could use a gym. Birx says that it is necessary that schools use fans to get enough fresh air. Difficult words: coordinator (a person who organizes activities and checks that people work together well), interpret (to understand what something means), fan (a device that moves and it makes the air fresh and cool). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A few months ago, schools around the world close. The reason is the coronavirus. Now, schools are opening again. However, some parents worry. They do not know if schools are safe for their children. In the US, the situation is different in each state. Many people are sick with COVID-19 in some cities. These are cities such as Houston, Miami, and Phoenix. Schools get information from the government. However, some information is not clear. Every school is different. Every school can understand some rules differently. Some schools can have outdoor classes. Some schools can use a large gym as a classroom. However, it is not always possible. Children in schools need fresh air. Schools must use fans to get enough fresh air for children. Difficult words: rule (what people must do), gym (a large room where people do sports), fan (a machine that moves and it makes the air fresh and cool). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

‘Glee’ star, Naya Rivera, is missing after taking a boat trip with her four-year-old son. Shortly before disappearing on Lake Piru near Los Angeles, California, she posted a photo of her and her son. Officials said that the 33-year-old actress rented a boat on Wednesday afternoon at the lake, and later, police found her son alone on the boat. The boy had a life vest on, and an adult life vest was found on the boat, too. Police helicopters and divers are scouring the lake for any sign of the missing actress; however, officials presume that she has drowned . Rivera is best known for a role in the TV show ‘Glee’ where she played a cheerleader named Santana Lopez for six years. Difficult words: life vest (a special type of clothing that makes people stay above water), scour (to search something thoroughly), presume (to guess based on evidence), drown (to die from being underwater and unable to breathe). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Naya Rivera is an American actress, who started her career when she was four years old. Most people know her for her role of a cheerleader , Santana Lopez, in the TV show ’Glee’. Rivera played in the show for six years, and she appeared in almost every episode. On Wednesday, Rivera rented a boat at Lake Piru near Los Angeles, California USA. She went on a trip with her four-year-old son. However, she did not return the boat. Police found the boat later, and only Rivera’s son was on board. The boy had a life vest on. Police found another life vest on the boat; however, Rivera was missing. Officials think that Rivera drowned , and police helicopters and divers are searching for her body. Difficult words: cheerleader (a girl or a woman who shouts at people at a sports event to support a team and to have fun), life vest (a vest that is full of air and it keeps people above water), drown (to die underwater). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Naya Rivera is an American actress. She is 33 years old. She has her first TV role when she is 4 years old. Rivera’s best known role is in the TV show ’Glee’. Rivera plays in the show for 6 years. Rivera is a singer, too. On Wednesday, Rivera takes a trip with her son. Her son is four years old. Rivera hires a boat in California, USA. She and her son go on a lake. Later, police find the boat. Rivera’s son is in the boat. However, police do not find Rivera. Officials think that Rivera dies in the lake. It is not easy to interview her small son. Police helicopters and divers try to find Rivera’s body in the lake. Difficult words: hire (when you pay money to be able to use something, usually a car or boat), interview (to ask somebody questions), diver (a person who swims under water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Kanye West is an American rapper, songwriter, producer and even a fashion designer. This week, West announced on Twitter that he is running for US president in this year’s election. West could still meet the deadline to run as an independent candidate in some states; however, some people speculate that West’s announcement is a publicity stunt . The rapper just released his latest single, and his new album will be released soon. West made a similar announcement a few times before. During MTV’s 2015 Video Music Awards, he said that he would run for president in 2020, and last year, he said that he would run for president in 2024’s election. It is unclear whether West has filed paperwork for his presidency with the Federal Election Commission. There seems to be no campaign committee set up for West for this year’s election. Difficult words: speculate (to guess possible answers to a question that somebody does not have enough information about), publicity stunt (a planned event designed to catch people’s attention), campaign committee (the team of people who help prepare a candidate, and they care about the financial matters of a campaign). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Kanye West is an American rapper and songwriter. Besides music, he is also a successful fashion designer. This week, West announced that he would run for US president as an independent candidate . The election takes place this year, and West still could meet the deadline in some states. However, some people do not believe that West wants to become president. Some people think that West wants to make more people interested in his work. West has just released his latest single, and he will release a new album soon. A candidate for US president must prepare many documents, and it is a long process. It is not clear if West is ready to become a candidate for US president. Difficult words: independent candidate (the person who wants to get a job, and he does not belong to any political party), election (when people choose someone for a job, usually in politics), deadline (the latest time or date when something is possible). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Kanye West is an American singer. He also writes songs. He is a fashion designer, too. He is 43 years old. He is very successful. West says that he wants to become a US president. The election is this year. However, it takes a long time to get ready for the election. West must prepare many papers. He needs a team of people. Nobody knows if West is ready. Some people say that West is a clever businessman . West has a new single . West will have a new album out soon. Some people think that West does not really want to be a president. However, West wants to make more people more interested in his music. Difficult words: election (when people vote for someone to get a job, usually in the government or politics), businessman (someone who works in business, or he knows how to make a lot of money), single (the most popular song in a music album). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Thursday morning, a truck driver in Louisiana, US, got the shock of his life as a small airplane soared only meters above his vehicle to make an emergency landing. The driver said that he did not hear anything until the plane came into sight and that he could not believe what he saw. Dashcam footage captured the moment of the plane coming down on the busy highway. The pilot, Howie Guidry, experienced engine trouble at 2,000 feet and there was no airport nearby. Guidry knew that he could not manage to return to an airport, and he remembered his training instructor’s guidance to seek out the biggest highway available. After a safe landing, Guidry and a mechanic, who was flying with him, quickly pushed the plane off the highway. Luckily, no one was injured in the incident. Difficult words: soar (to fly in the air), dashcam (a video camera that is used to record the view of the road from inside a vehicle), seek out (to search). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Thursday morning, a truck driver was driving on a highway in Louisiana, US. Suddenly, the driver saw a small plane that flew only meters above the truck. He was shocked when the plane landed on the highway before the truck. The pilot, Howie Guidry, had problems with the engine. The plane was 2,000 feet above the ground when the engine stopped working. Guidry could not return to the airport, and there was no airport nearby. Guidry had to make an emergency landing . He remembered the advice of his instructor to land on the biggest highway that he could find. When Guidry landed safely, his mechanic and he quickly pushed the plane off the highway. Difficult words: emergency landing (when a plane must land, usually because it has a problem or the weather is bad), instructor (a teacher), mechanic (a person who repairs or looks after vehicles and machines). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A truck driver is driving on a highway. Suddenly, the driver sees a small plane. The plane is flying above the highway. The plane lands on the highway. The driver is very surprised. Howie Guidry is the pilot of the plane. He has problems with the engine . He must make an emergency landing . However, the airport is far away. He cannot return to the airport. He remembers his teacher’s words. The pilot must find a big road. The plane lands safely on the highway. However, it is a dangerous situation. Guidry and his mechanic must quickly move the plane away. The situation ends well. Nobody gets hurt. Difficult words: engine (a machine that makes something move), emergency landing (when a plane has problems and it must land), mechanic (a person who repairs and looks after machines). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Approximately 48 million people have some degree of hearing loss. Ordinary masks muffle our voice, and it may be worth considering masks with clear windows. When you wear such a mask, people can see your lips, which can be helpful for people who are deaf or hard of hearing. Window masks make it possible to lipread and to see facial expressions. Alicia Austin teaches infants and children who are deaf or hard of hearing. Currently, Austin has many online lessons with her students, and she says that wearing a mask can make communication very difficult. Austin says that children need to see facial expressions and recognition in order to learn, regardless of hearing abilities. There are more benefits to window masks. They can be very helpful also to people with diminished hearing, typically older people or grandparents, who rely on face-to-face interaction to understand Difficult words: muffle (to make a sound quieter and less clear), lipread (to watch someone’s lip movements in order to understand what he is saying), diminished (smaller or reduced). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Millions of people all around the world are wearing face masks now. However, for some people, communication with others can be very difficult with masks on their faces. About 48 million people have problems with hearing . Some people are deaf which means that they cannot hear. Some people, usually older people, cannot hear well. For these people who have problems with hearing, lipreading is very important. These people need to see other people’s lips and how they move. This way, they can understand what the speaker is saying. A mask is also some kind of a barrier between people, and it can make people feel more distant. A team of fashion designers made a special mask with a window. People can see each other’s lips and facial expressions . For many people, this mask makes communication much easier. Difficult words: hearing (when you hear noises and sounds through your ears), lipreading (when you watch a person’s lips and how they move, and it helps you understand what the person is saying), barrier (something that makes it difficult for people to understand each other), facial expression (if a person looks happy, sad, angry, surprised, and so on). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people have problems with hearing . Some people are deaf. It means that they cannot hear. However, they need to communicate with others. These people often lipread . They watch other people’s lips. It helps them understand. Now, people must wear masks. The reason is the coronavirus. People cover their faces. It is a big problem for deaf people. They do not see people’s lips. Some people do not feel good. They need to see other people’s faces. It is important to see their faces. We can see if people smile or not. Masks make communication difficult. A team of fashion designers have a clever idea. They make a mask with a window. The mask covers the mouth. However, people can see each other’s lips. Difficult words: hearing (when you hear noises through your ears), communicate/communication (to talk or make movements to tell someone something; when you talk or make movements to tell someone something), lipread (to watch somebody’s lips to be able to understand what he is saying), cover (when you place something over a thing, and other people cannot see the thing). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Entertainment company Cirque du Soleil has filed for bankruptcy due to the coronavirus pandemic. The Canada-based circus arts show announced on Monday that the filing is a response to immense disruption and forced show closures. The company also said that it had to lay off about 3,500 employees in order to help curb further financial loss. However, the company plans to rehire a lot of the staff when official restrictions are lifted. Cirque du Soleil has resident shows in Las Vegas and Orlando, USA, and these shows are expected to start before other shows. Therefore, performers and staff members there are not among the laid off people. Difficult words: disruption (problems that interrupt an event or activity), lay off (to make somebody leave his job), curb (to limit). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Cirque du Soleil is an entertainment company, and it is the largest circus producer in the world. The company is located in Canada; however, its shows are popular all over the world. On Monday, the company said that it had big financial problems. The company filed for bankruptcy which means that it cannot pay its debts . The reason for Cirque du Soleil’s troubles is the coronavirus. The company had to stop its shows, and it lost a lot of money. 3,500 employees had to leave the company. However, the company plans to hire some people when the shows start again and when the situation gets better. Difficult words: circus (artists and clowns who perform shows for people, usually in a big tent), bankruptcy (when a business or a does not make money and asks for help from the government), debts (when you must pay money to someone else). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Cirque du Soleil is a famous company. The company makes shows for people. Artists and acrobats make the shows. Cirque du Soleil is a Canadian company. However, it has shows in all the world. Now, the company has a lot of problems with money. The coronavirus stops the shows. The rules are strict. People must stay at home. The company does not get money from tickets. The company must fire 3,500 workers. The company does not have money for their salaries . When the situation gets better, the company wants to hire some workers again. However, nobody knows when the shows can start again. Difficult words: acrobat (the person who performs difficult gymnastic acts), fire (to make someone lose his job), salary (the money that you get for work). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A Russian couple built a replica of the Great Pyramid in Giza, Egypt in their garden. The structure is made from modern concrete blocks, and it is 19 times smaller than the original in Egypt. However, it is still impressive in size, with each size measuring more than 42 feet in length, and its tower reaching 29.5 feet above the ground. The couple spent two years studying the design, and in June 2019, they began construction behind their summer residence. The pyramid is located in a small village approximately 7 miles outside St. Petersburg. People come to visit the structure, both for spiritual practices and out of curiosity . Difficult words: replica (an exact smaller copy), concrete (a building material), out of curiosity (when someone does something because he wants to know or learn something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A Russian couple built a copy of the Great Pyramid in Giza, Egypt. They built the pyramid in the garden behind their summer home near St. Petersburg. Andrey and Viktoria Vakhrusheva used concrete blocks to build a pyramid that is 19 times smaller that the original pyramid in Egypt. The pyramid is smaller; however, it is still very big. Its sizes are more than 42 feet long and its tower is 29.5 feet high. The couple studied the original pyramid very carefully, and it took them two years to plan the building. Currently, many people come to visit the pyramid. Some people take part in spiritual activities, and some people are only interested in the building itself. Difficult words: concrete (a grey building material), block (a large piece of hard material), spiritual (related to what someone feels and believes). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A Russian couple builds a pyramid. The pyramid is a copy of the biggest pyramid in the world. The biggest pyramid is in Giza, Egypt. The couple builds their pyramid in the garden. They study the pyramid in Egypt for two years. They want to know every detail . The copy must be correct and true. Their pyramid is 19 times smaller than the original pyramid. However, it is still very big. Its sizes are more than 42 feet long. Its tower is almost 30 feet high. Many people come to see the pyramid. They want to see how it looks. Some people like to do spiritual activities in the pyramid. Difficult words: copy (when something looks similar to something else), detail (one part of a whole thing), spiritual (connected to what you believe and feel). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A 7.4- magnitude earthquake hit southern Mexico on Tuesday, and it killed six people. The earthquake just added to the challenges and misery of the coronavirus pandemic, as medical workers and patients from Mexico City hospitals had to be evacuated. However, even the earthquake could not top the daily shock of the coronavirus. In Mexico, nearly 24,000 people have died from COVID-19, and almost 200,000 people have been infected. Mexico’s president quickly assured the population after the earthquake; however, some people criticize his actions to stop the spread of the coronavirus. Mexico is one of the world’s most seismically active regions, and the country has a long history of devastating earthquakes and volcanic eruptions. Difficult words: magnitude (a measure of how strong an earthquake is), top (to exceed), seismically active (with frequent earthquakes). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A very strong earthquake hit southern Mexico on Tuesday. The earthquake destroyed many buildings, and it killed six people. The earthquake also damaged several hospitals, and officials had to evacuate many patients and medical workers. Two of the hospitals treated patients with COVID-19. In Mexico, almost 24,000 people died from COVID-19, and nearly 200,000 got sick with COVID-19. The situation was very serious, and the earthquake made it even worse. Earthquakes are very common in Mexico, because the country lies on top of three large tectonic plates . The plates move, and they cause earthquakes and volcanic eruptions. In the past, there were very many strong earthquakes in Mexico, and they killed thousands of people. Difficult words: evacuate (to take someone to a safe place), treat (to look after patients), tectonic plate (a big piece of rock that moves and it makes the surface of the Earth). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
